mentions.name: Murajah
mentions.description: A web app and Android app published on Google Play, developed as an experiment to see how far AI models have progressed. The full codebase, implementation, debugging, and deployment—including the code to generate the Google Play APK—were produced with AI agents via GitHub Copilot MCPs in VS Code, mostly Claude Haiku 4.5 with Sonnet 4.5 or GPT-5 Codex used when debugging stalled; the author reviewed the source code before committing and helped debug by suggesting ideas and algorithms. Source code is available on GitHub.
